evals.name: blocking-wf-solo-first
evals.prompt: Run ws-next when terminal ship moves exist and WF4 blocks unit dep
evals.expected_output: Strategy picker leads with WF4 solo blocking line before batch lanes

evals.name: design-only-suggest
evals.prompt: Run ws-next on empty workstream with design spec only
evals.expected_output: Strategy picker shows From design spec lane only (plus Not now)

evals.name: chain-decline-prints-command
evals.prompt: User picks Propose from design spec then Not now at candidate picker during Chain
evals.expected_output: Skill requires printing default move resolved command; store untouched

evals.name: focus-headline-lane-order
evals.prompt: Run ws-next in suggest mode with active focus and open follow-ups
evals.expected_output: From focus lane appears before non-blocking follow-up lanes

evals.name: mid-flight-single-move-chain
evals.prompt: Run ws-next when one unit is mid-flight (1 of 6 tasks left) and a design spec exists; another agent owns the in-flight work
evals.expected_output: Chain picker runs (does not skip to hook): Not now, in-flight move [default], Propose from design spec last — not preselected

evals.name: restack-blocks-propose
evals.prompt: Run ws-next when a unit needs restack and design exists
evals.expected_output: No Propose next unit in Chain; hook for restack only

evals.name: chain-many-followups-summary
evals.prompt: Run ws-next when one unit is mid-flight, design exists, and 28+ open WF follow-ups are proposable
evals.expected_output: Chain offers Propose from design spec and Propose from Workstream follow-ups; no generic Propose next unit
